description: Open cursor A, a dynaset on T, read RecordCount and the first row's ID and K through held Fields. Through cursor B, a second dynaset on T in the same Database: FindFirst/Edit/Update K = 111 on visited row ID 1 and K = 444 on unvisited row ID 4, FindFirst/Delete unvisited row ID 3, AddNew/Update row (6, 60, 'f'); close B. Then on A: RecordCount, walk ID and K by MoveNext to EOF from the current row, RecordCount; MoveFirst and walk again; Requery, RecordCount and walk again. Asks which membership and value changes made through another cursor A shows, before and after Requery. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
